messages.subject: Error bars using marginal_effects()
parts:
Hi brms users,

When a categorical interaction is plotted using marginal_effects(). What is the definition of the error bars? Are these credible intervals for the joint posterior distribution marginalizing for other variables in the model?

Best,

Edward

messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] Error bars using marginal_effects()
